ideas.pitch: A futuristic pop-up boba tea stall concept featuring an AI flavor-combinator kiosk that projects personalized holographic drink avatars based on user mood inputs.
ideas.title: NeonBoba: Interactive AR Boba Stall Concept
ideas.why_it_could_win: It directly targets the fest stall theme by combining physical engagement with generative visuals, maximizing foot traffic and memorability for judges looking for pure creativity and consumer appeal.

ideas.pitch: A dessert stall concept themed around time travel, featuring interactive mechanical menu displays and a custom web app where visitors order customized pastries mapped to historical eras.
ideas.title: ChronoCakes: Kinetic Time-Lapse Pastry Bar
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on immersive storytelling, thematic branding, and product positioning rather than complex backend engineering, perfectly aligning with the fest stall evaluation criteria.

ideas.pitch: A live merchandise stall concept where festival-goers use an intuitive touch-screen interface to generate abstract AI art patterns printed instantly onto tote bags and badges.
ideas.title: PixelPrint: Custom Generative Merch Stall
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages real-time visual creation to deliver an unforgettable interactive experience that judges can instantly visualize operating on a college fest ground.

ideas.pitch: A snack and beverage stall wrapped inside a nostalgic 8-bit arcade cabinet theme, featuring mini-browser games that unlock menu discounts based on high scores.
ideas.title: RetroArcade Cafe: Play-to-Win Snack Stall
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines gamification with retail branding, providing a complete brand identity and interactive engagement loop that easily stands out in a pitch presentation.

ideas.pitch: A sustainability-themed smoothie stall concept featuring an interactive carbon-offset tracker displayed on the storefront and edible plantable seed-paper cups.
ideas.title: EcoSnap: Zero-Waste Botanical Smoothie Bar
ideas.why_it_could_win: Taps into modern consumer trends around sustainability and circular economies, presenting a tightly integrated brand strategy and physical stall design.
